range.name: Range check
range.description: Checks if the value falls within a specified range

battery_v.name: Battery voltage check
battery_v.description: Checks that the battery voltage level is above the threshold

samples.name: Samples check
samples.description: Checks if the number of samples taken in measuring period are too low.

spike.name: Spike check
spike.description: Checks for individual spikes in data that exceed a threshold

nr01_temp.name: Radiometer temperature check
nr01_temp.description: Removes LWIN and LWOUT where radiometer temperature out of range

hfp_removal.name: Heat flux plates check
hfp_removal.description: Removes G1 and G2 for 0:30 and 1:00 while plates are heating up to calibrate

pluvio_diag.name: Pluvio Diagnostic
pluvio_diag.description: Removes precip where pluvio diagnostic value > 0

snowd_signal.name: Snow distance signal
snowd_signal.description: Removes snow depth where signal value too low

tdt_tsoil.name: TDT soil temp
tdt_tsoil.description: Removes TDT VWC where TDT soil temperature too low
